column3: state: pit luma follows Anim_LoungeBG's light phase; verified. Run 61 shot at lights=1.26 s (before the 1.5-4 s spike): pit [83,132,137] luma x1.06 (01.jpg) / x1.09 (02.jpg). Independent sweep pit-run10 pit-t00..t39 (region 0.52-0.80x0.42-0.62): luma 118 at 0-1 s, 130 at 2 s peak, 109-112 at 7-14 s, 118 at 18 s; clip 111-112. The skip rule only excludes 1.5-4 s; 1.26 s is neither the minimum (7 s, 109) nor the peak, so it is not cherry-picked and hides at most the ~x1.06-1.09 residual. The flicker claim holds for luma

pit/scene hue: ours is bluer than the clip at EVERY light phase. pit B/G 1.04 (run 61) vs clip 0.96/0.95; over the whole 20 s sweep B/G is 1.01-1.05 (never <1.01), so not phase. pit B 137 vs 119.7/116.8 (x1.15/x1.17) while R matches (83 vs 83/78); frame B 35.1 vs 31.3/30.8 (x1.12), ring B/G 1.17 vs 0.98/1.04, menu B/G 1.08 vs 0.99/1.03. Neutrals match (logo white, options frame). Minor (<=18 channel units, under the 25 gate) and could be clip video chroma, but it is systematic; clip pit also sits under more smoke haze, ours is a saturated cyan. Not explained by the flicker claim

logo: 'VOID DIVER' and 'Escape from the Abyss' carry a 1-2 px RGB-split fringe (red/yellow left edge, cyan right edge); the clip's logo (02.jpg) is clean white. Bright logo pixels with |R-B|>90: 3298 of 11026 (30%) in run 61, 4201 of 11477 in the committed run-60 shot, 0 of 9360 in 02.jpg (01.jpg is blurred, no fringe). Menu text and corner buttons have 0 fringe in both, so it is the logo only (a chromatic-aberration / glitch effect on the logo that the clip does not show; check whether it is an animated glitch pulse and shot at its peak). Size, font, x match; 17 px lower = the clip's own offset
menu text and spacing: same font, size and 56 px pitch; baselines 17 px lower than the clip on every line (the clip's own upward offset)
